claims: The Denver Pioneers won their 11th NCAA men's ice hockey national championship.
The Denver Pioneers' 11th NCAA men's ice hockey national championship is a new record.
The Denver Pioneers defeated the Wisconsin Badgers 2-1 on April 11, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA men's ice hockey championship game was at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV.
The championship game concluded the 2026 Frozen Four tournament.
The Denver Pioneers defeated Michigan 4-3 in 2OT in Semifinal 2 of the 2026 Frozen Four.
The Wisconsin Badgers defeated North Dakota 2-1 in Semifinal 1 of the 2026 Frozen Four.
The 2026 Frozen Four included Denver, Wisconsin, Michigan, and North Dakota.
The Wisconsin Badgers were the 2026 runner-up.
This victory marks the Denver Pioneers' third national title in five years.
The Denver Pioneers won their 2024 championship.
